name: Pro Inline Comment Threads
description: Google-Docs style review comments on a Tiptap document: text-range anchors, a sidebar aligned to anchors with collision-free, virtualised cards, replies, reactions, @mentions, resolve/reopen, open/mine/resolved filters and optimistic writes with rollback via TanStack Query.

props.name: documentId
props.description: Scopes the query cache and every adapter call

props.name: adapter
props.description: listThreads / createThread / addReply / toggleReaction / setResolved / deleteComment? — all async, applied optimistically and rolled back on rejection

props.name: users
props.description: People who can be shown and @mentioned

props.name: currentUserId
props.description: Author of new comments; drives the “For me” filter

props.name: onActiveThreadChange
props.description: Active thread changed (card click, cursor in anchor, keyboard)

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Disable creating, replying, reacting and resolving

props.name: reactions
props.description: Emoji offered in the reaction picker

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the scrolling review surface

props.name: queryClient
props.description: Share the host app's TanStack QueryClient

props.name: onContentChange
props.description: Document HTML (including anchors) after any change, for persistence

props.name: onError
props.description: An optimistic write was rolled back

usage: Select text, then click Comment in the bubble menu or press Ctrl+Alt+M. In the sidebar: Arrow Up/Down (or j/k) moves between threads, Enter focuses a thread's anchor, Escape clears. In a composer type @ to mention (Arrow keys + Enter), Ctrl+Enter sends. Persist `onContentChange` HTML so anchors survive reloads; threads whose anchor text was deleted are shown as Detached. The anchor mark is built in-house because Tiptap's comments extension is proprietary.
